name: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2016, Utkarsh Small Finance Bank is engaged in providing banking and financial services.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
Utkarsh Small Finance Bank (USFB) has evolved from a microfinance institution to a small finance bank. It has a significant presence in rural and semi-urban areas, focusing on financial inclusion

pros: Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 70.0 days to 15.2 days
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -26.2%
Company has a low return on equity of 12.8% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.628 Cr.
Dividend payout has been low at 3.68% of profits over last 3 years
